messages.subject: Postdoc in hierarchical modeling with the Karp and Sollmann labs at UC Davis
parts:
We are seeking candidates for a Postdoc position at UC Davis to work with Conservation International’s Wildlife Insights team on exploring regional-to-global trends in wildlife occupancy across space and time. Please see link for a full job description and application instructions.

https://karp.ucdavis.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/310/2020/06/QuantitativeWildlifeEcology_Postdoc_JobAd.pdf
